name: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold
summary: You return to Feathermoon Stronghold with news of a strange gazebo at the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal. General Shandris Feathermoon awaits your report.

sections.title: Carrying the Report Home
sections.body: At Feathermoon Stronghold, General Shandris Feathermoon awaits your news of the strange gazebo. You carry your findings back from the heart of the ruins so she can hear what you saw.

sections.title: On Your Return
sections.body: Shandris finds your report on the gazebo disturbing. The naga may not have meant to attack, yet their continued presence bodes ill for the push into Feralas. Feathermoon Stronghold needs more help against the Hatecrest naga, and Shandris offers you further work if you are willing.

faq.q: Who do I report to after the ruins?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
where to turn in return to feathermoon stronghold
faq.answer: Report to General Shandris Feathermoon at Feathermoon Stronghold.
Tell General Shandris Feathermoon about the strange gazebo at the center of the Ruins of Solarsal.
The Ruins of Solarsal comes before your return. Shandris sent you to explore the ruins and investigate the naga there.
